notes.title: NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENT: 'Advent: Dawn'—The next in our Sci-fi Mystery Series
notes.content:
Announcing 'Advent: Dawn'—The Next Chapter in Our Sci-fi Visual Novel Series

We’re excited to share the first look at Advent: Dawn, our upcoming sci-fi mystery visual novel and the next story set in the same universe as SYNESTHESIA

In Advent: Dawn, seven strangers are trapped in a vast underground cave beneath a remote island. With fear mounting and trust breaking apart, they must find a way to escape—or risk becoming part of the cave’s secrets forever.

If you enjoyed the storytelling and atmosphere of SYNESTHESIA we hope you’ll join us for this next adventure. You can check out the Steam page and add it to your wishlist here:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820260/Advent_Dawn/"][/dynamiclink]WISHLIST 'Advent: Dawn' HERE!

Thank you so much for your continued support.[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820260/Advent_Dawn/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: SYNESTHESIA Console Release + New Game in Development!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’re excited to share two huge updates with you.

SYNESTHESIA Console Release
Thanks to all of your support on Steam, SYNESTHESIA is now available on consoles! You can now play it on:

 Nintendo Switch
 PlayStation 4 & PlayStation 5
 Xbox One & Xbox Series X|S
More details are available through our publishing partner here:
https://www.ratalaikagames.com/games.php?id=synesthesia

This marks a big milestone for us, and we’re grateful to our Steam community for helping make this possible. Every bit of feedback and encouragement has helped the game grow!

New Game in Development

We’re also excited to announce we are currently working on a new title — a narrative-driven mystery escape visual novel that blends science fiction with mystical elements. It will feature:

 An immersive, story-rich setting with impacting character moments
 A mystery that challenges trust, memory and the human spirit; filled with twists and reveals
 Original soundtrack, voice acting and flowchart
This is easily our best work yet, with a story filled with twists and mind-bending ideas that we can't wait for you to experience. Development is well underway, we are currently at 44% complete and are eyeing a release date of late 2025 / early 2026.

Join our discord HERE for ongoing updates leading up to release. We look forward to sharing the Steam page and title reveal soon!

Thank you for continuing to support our work! It's everyone who has supported us here on Steam that has made this possible.

Spire Games.

notes.title: Cloud Saves, Voice Patch & More!
notes.content:
This update implements:
- Cloud Saves! Save files can now be synced between different devices across all three supported OSs.
- A Voice EQ Patch. All sound files have been edited and EQ'd for greater clarity and consistency. 
- Minor script changes: Some wording has been changed (mostly in the TRUE route) to add greater clarity. No plot points have been altered. 

It also includes all prior fixes included on earlier updates.

It is highly recommended to update the game for the best experience.

To connect or for more information / support, visit our discord.

Thanks, Spire Games.

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
Update - June 28th.

All known errors have been fixed with this update. Please note that none of the prior errors were game breaking and most were rare. However, if you installed the game prior to June 28th it's recommended you update the game for the most polished experience.

The update patch includes fixes for:

- All typos and grammatical errors that slipped past the proof-reader have been fixed
- Fixes a strange occasional bug on tip 14
- Fixed a rare occurrence of some tips and endings being unlocked on opening the game
- Renamed the description of an achievement to make it clearer where it will unlock (Space Master)
- Fixed numbering on load / save slots
- Fixed rare issue where the Space Enforcers minigame runs too fast
- Fixed rare error of an early unlocking of the CG Gallery

If you have updated your game and still experience an error of some form, the best place to reach us is on the discord here - we will respond as soon as we can.

Thanks, and enjoy SYNESTEHSIA.

Spire Games.
